registryBasis: The City of Oakland GIS publishes the GISADMIN.AC_PARCELS_2023 polygon layer, explicitly extracted from county parcels and clipped to Oakland city limits. Its public ArcGIS REST feature layer supports geometry queries. A bounded response was retrieved with only OBJECTID and APN_1 requested; no owner/address attributes were requested.

officialSources.observation: Layer GISADMIN.AC_PARCELS_2023; polygon geometry; county parcels extracted and clipped to Oakland city limits; public ArcGIS REST query; maximum record count 1000; spatial reference 2227. Fields include OBJECTID and APN_1; query restricted to those fields.

Bounded WGS84 envelope query returned HTTP 200 and three Polygon features using outFields=OBJECTID,APN_1, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, resultRecordCount=3. Three safe APNs retained only in the three-feature adapter sample.
